identity.title: An ALMA archival study of the clump mass function in the Large Magellanic Cloud
identity.journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

paper_type_evidence.quote: The data were taken as part of two projects retrieved from the alma public archive plus one project observed specifically for this work.
derived from public archival alma observations.

question.value: What is the dust-derived clump mass function of star forming regions in the LMC, and how does it compare with Milky Way core/clump mass functions?

evidence.quote: we calculate and analyze the dust-derived clump mass function in the lmc to facilitate comparison with mass functions of star forming regions in the Milky Way.

bands.value: Band 3 (~3.2 mm) and Band 6 (~1.3 mm) continuum

evidence.quote: we focused on continuum observations from 86 GHz to 100 GHz ({\sim}3.2 mm) and 217 GHz to 233 GHz ({\sim}1.3 mm) in alma’s Bands 3 and 6, respectively.
Effective bandwidths used in making the continuum maps ranged between 1.6 GHz and 4 GHz.

arrays.value: 12 m plus ACA (7 m); N113 main array only

evidence.quote: 12 m (main array) plus aca data were obtained for all fields except N113, which was observed as a single pointing and only with the main array.
The average synthesized beam size was {\sim}2.3 ″ corresponding to {\sim}0.6
The projects were observed between 2011 December 31 and 2017 April 21 spanning Cycles 0, 1, 2, & 4.

provided.value: 4.8 and 8.4 GHz radio images of 30 Dor and N159 used to test free-free decomposition

evidence.quote: 4.8 GHz (6 cm) and 8.4 GHz (3 cm) observations were made of 30 Doradus (cite: Laz2003) and N159 (cite: Ind2004) with the atca.

evidence.loc: 3.3 Converting dust flux to total gas mass
evidence.quote: The dust temperature and opacity were calculated from the (cite: Gor2014) temperature and emissivity maps

what.value: dust emissivity index beta=1.49 from LMC-wide Herschel SED fits (bembb)

evidence.quote: We use an average value for the dust emissivity spectral index of $\beta=1.49$ from the (cite: Gor2014) lmc-wide dust sed fits to Herschel observations.

evidence.loc: 3.3 Converting dust flux to total gas mass
evidence.quote: we applied a conversion to total gas mass through a g2d ratio of 500 from (cite: Rom2017).

what.value: Milky Way core/clump double power law fits for comparison

evidence.quote: using the best fit parameters reported by (cite: Rei2006b) will remove any variability introduced in the fitting step.

pipeline_or_manual.value: Dor: archive calibrated visibilities with statwt reweighting; others re-run manual scripts or pipeline

evidence.quote: dor had calibrated visibilities available and we used those data after recalculating the weights based upon the scatter in the visibilities using the casa `statwt` command.

casa_version.value: CASA 4.7.2-REL (r39762) for manual calibration; pipeline data used CASA closest to observatory version

evidence.quote: in the latest version of casa available at the time, 4.7.2-REL (r39762).

task.value: CASA 4.7.2 clean, multi-frequency synthesis, psfmode psfclark

evidence.quote: with the `robust` parameter set to 0.5, in multi-frequency synthesis mode, with `psfmode` set to “psfclark”
setting `robust` to 2.0 to favor s/n over resolution.

uv_taper.value: Band 3 uv trimmed at Band 6 minimum uv; Band 6 tapered to Band 3 beam, restoringbeam forced

evidence.quote: we used the `restoringbeam` parameter in `clean` to force the Band 6 Gaussian beam shape to be the same as that of the Band 3 map.

masking.value: auto-masking script based on M100 CASA guide; thresholds 1.5–3 x noise; min mask 0.5 beam

evidence.quote: All auto-masking was done with stopping thresholds between 1.5 and 3 times the noise in the map and using minimum mask areas of 0.5 times the map synthesized beam.

line_free_channels.value: strong lines identified with plotms and flagged

evidence.quote: Strong emission lines were identified with the plotms task and flagged before the visiblities were imaged to produce continuum maps.

what.value: Auto-masking algorithm based on M100 CASA guide

evidence.quote: This algorithm is heavily based upon the auto-masking code given in the M100 casa Guide as it appeared in August, 2016.

what.value: Fitting weights and Monte Carlo uncertainty approach

evidence.quote: To estimate fitting weights we followed the approach used by (cite: Rei2006a)

what.value: ClumpFind contour settings tested against synthetic detection

evidence.quote: This combination of lowest contour level and contour spacing was also shown to result in the lowest number of missed and “false” clumps

unstated_but_needed: Line-free channel/spw selections per field for continuum imaging
Exact uv-trim values for Band 3 and taper values per field (partly in table)
Auto-masking code is only in a thesis appendix
Band 3 and Band 6 central frequencies used in the combination
Data weights/flux calibrator choices per project

method.value: Trim Band 3 uv, taper Band 6 to Band 3 beam, clean with auto-masking, Briggs robust 0.5

evidence.quote: Matching the spatial scale sensitivities was achieved through a combination of trimming the shortest uv-spacings and tapering the weighting of the longest uv-spacings.
Differences between the Band 6 and Band 3 beam axes were \<10 per cent (and usually much less)

method.value: Solve S_B6=S_d+S_ff and S_B3 scaled with (2+beta) and -0.1 indices algebraically per pixel

evidence.quote: We combine the Band 3 and Band 6 images using Equation [\[eq:b6_dust_only\]](#eq:b6_dust_only) to produce dust-only emission maps for our fields.
We use an average value for the dust emissivity spectral index of $\beta=1.49$

assumptions.value: Only dust and free-free contribute; synchrotron neglected (<=4 per cent of Band 6 oversubtracted)

evidence.quote: This results in, at most, four per cent of the total Band 6 flux being oversubtracted

validation.value: Compared with ATCA 4.8/8.4 GHz extrapolated free-free: dor within 15 per cent, N159W consistent, N159E ~4x discrepant

evidence.quote: the total free-free emission in dor matches within 15 per cent between extrapolated and decomposed estimates (0.82 Jy and 0.97 Jy, respectively).

method.value: ClumpFind lowest contour 3 rms, spacing 2 rms, fwhm=0 with minpix 56 (dor, N159W) or 61 (N159E), no background subtraction

evidence.quote: The lowest contour was set to three times the map rms
56 for dor and N159W and 61 for N159E.
we inspected the clump regions identified with ClumpFind visually for each field.

method.value: M_d = S d^2/(kappa B(T_d)), times g2d

evidence.loc: 3.3 Converting dust flux to total gas mass
evidence.quote: M_{\mathrm{d}} = \frac{S d^{2}}{\kappa B(T_{\mathrm{d}})}
with $T_{\mathrm{d}}=\SI{36.7}{\kelvin}$, $\kappa_{\SI{1.3}{\milli\metre}}=\SI{1.16}{\square\centi\metre\per\gram}$, and g2d$=\num{500}$.

method.value: Inject 600 beam-sized Gaussian sources per mass bin, rerun ClumpFind, fit logistic function; N_corr=N/f using dor curve

evidence.quote: We inject 600 synthetic sources per mass bin.

assumptions.value: Tested only beam-size sources, likely overestimating completeness

evidence.quote: our completeness estimates are likely overestimating the total fraction of clumps recovered for a given mass.
We fit each completeness curve with a standard logistic function

method.value: Double power law fit with Levenberg-Marquardt; weights as in Reid; Monte Carlo of mass uncertainties for errors; also lognormal

evidence.quote: we carried out our fits with the standard nonlinear Levenberg-Marquardt least-squares minimization

fitting.value: Levenberg-Marquardt least squares; MC with ×10^5 artificial mass functions, inner 68 per cent for 1sigma

evidence.quote: From the distributions of fit parameters we used the inner 68 per cent to obtain the 1$\sigma$ uncertainties on each fit parameter

validation.value: fit with M>500 only statistically indistinguishable

evidence.quote: The best fit double power laws for the two methods end up being statistically indistinguishable
carried out in casa 4.7.2[^3] (r39762) for all fields.
we used the ClumpFind algorithm (cite: Wil1994) available in Starlink[^6] through the Cupid package
This research made use of Astropy, a community-developed core Python package for Astronomy
This research made use of APLpy, an open-source plotting package for Python
A total of 32 dust clumps were identified in three fields (dor, N159W and N159E)
$\alpha_{\mathrm{high}} = -3.3 \pm 0.2$
with masses ranging between 205 and 5740.

results_numeric.quantity: Mass sensitivity (1 sigma) dor, N159W, N159E

evidence.loc: 3.3 Converting dust flux to total gas mass
evidence.quote: results in mass sensitivities (1$\sigma$) of 45, 85, and 72

findings_qualitative.value: Free-free emission is significant even at 1.3 mm and shifts the mass function to lower masses

evidence.loc: 3.3 Converting dust flux to total gas mass
evidence.quote: our free-free correction is significantly larger than the random noise in each clump and systematically shifts the clump mass function to smaller masses.

claims.hypothesis: The LMC dust clump mass function is consistent with CO-derived and Milky Way mass functions
claims.experiment: Double power law fit to 32 completeness-corrected clump masses; comparison to Reid et al. 2006 and Indebetouw 2013
claims.result: alpha_low=-1.76, alpha_high=-3.3, break 2500 Msun; agrees with Indebetouw slope -1.9
claims.finding: LMC low-mass index matches high-mass indices of several Milky Way regions, suggesting extension of the MW power law

evidence.quote: This agreement may indicate an extension of the Milky Way power law to higher masses than previously observed.

claims.hypothesis: Band 3 and Band 6 can be combined to remove free-free contamination
claims.experiment: Algebraic decomposition tested against ATCA radio extrapolation
claims.result: dor within 15 per cent, N159W consistent, N159E ~4x too much free-free

evidence.quote: we believe the radio free-free emission estimates agree well enough

why_this_method.value: ClumpFind chosen for direct comparison with previous work

evidence.quote: We chose to use this algorithm to facilitate direct comparison with previous work that also used ClumpFind.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: N113 excluded from mass function due to non-trivial free-free emission and no 3.2 mm data

evidence.quote: We are not able to include N113 in our final mass function analysis

limitations_admitted.value: CASA <5.0 7m mosaic flux scaling issue: Band 6 overestimated ~8 per cent, Band 3 ~2 per cent, not corrected

evidence.quote: the Band 6 flux densities are overestimated by \sim 8 per cent and Band 3 by \sim 2 per cent.

limitations_admitted.value: Completeness tested only for beam-sized sources

evidence.quote: we only tested source recovery for sources that were the same size as the synthesized beam

referee_caveats_inferred: Small sample (32 clumps), mostly from one region
Single dust temperature, opacity and g2d for all clumps
Fit weights from cumulative counts correlated

evidence.quote: We retrieved six publicly available projects from the alma archive
